fonts.usage: Hero headlines, section titles, book titles. Elegant, emotional, cinematic.
Body text, paragraphs, labels, small text, metadata. Highly readable.

typography.guidelines: Use tracking-tight for large headings (text-4xl to text-6xl). Never use text-7xl or above for headings. Maintain high contrast. Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines and category labels.

tailwind_classes.primary_button: bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)] hover:bg-blue-500 hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(59,130,246,0.8)] transition-all duration-300
tailwind_classes.secondary_button: bg-transparent border border-[#C0C0C0] text-white hover:bg-white/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(192,192,192,0.3)] transition-all duration-300

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use on sticky header, product cards, floating audio players, and dropdowns. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Electric blue shadows on primary buttons. Silver subtle glow on secondary buttons. Glowing buttons are a key brand element.
visual_enhancers.textures: Cinematic dark feel. Avoid flat, lifeless grays. Always tint grays with a hint of blue to match the storm aesthetic. Add a subtle noise/grain overlay site-wide if possible.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or rounded-md. Must have explicit hover states with increased glow. Primary buttons glow electric blue, secondary buttons glow silver.
components.cards: Glassmorphism cards for books and merchandise. Hovering lifts the card (-translate-y-1) and increases border opacity (border-white/30) and adds a subtle shadow.
components.header: Sticky nav with backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60 (NOT fully transparent). Must contain brand logo text 'STORM & ME OFFICIAL', nav links, cart, search, social icons, and 'Shop Now' button.
components.hero: Full-screen (min-h-screen). Absolute positioning for the rain/lightning background. Content centered with Playfair Display heading 'Some people run from the storm. I learned how to create inside it.'. Primary and secondary action buttons.
components.audio_player: Sticky or inline glassmorphism component for music preview with play/pause and progress bar.
components.dropdowns: Must have a dark semi-solid background (e.g. bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700). Never completely transparent.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for major sections. Grid gaps gap-8 to gap-12.
layouts.grid: Bento-style or asymmetrical grids for featured books and merchandise. Avoid boring symmetrical 3-column grids everywhere. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 for visual interest.

motion.site_wide: Use react-tsparticles for full-screen realistic rain effect (fixed, z-[-1], pointer-events-none). Must not block clicks.
motion.lightning: CSS keyframe animation on a fixed absolute div that flashes opacity briefly (0 -> 0.15 -> 0) every 12-25 seconds randomly to light up the background.
motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for page transitions (fade and slight slide up) and scroll-triggered reveals (staggered list item entrances).
motion.hover: Smooth scale and glow adjustments on cards and buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over glass or images has sufficient contrast. Use text shadows if necessary.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Rain and lightning MUST be disabled or severely reduced if prefers-reduced-motion is enabled in CSS/JS.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, forms) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-shop-button').

media.instructions: Use these exact URLs. DO NOT use placeholders. Apply max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none to mobile images.

3d_libraries.particles: react-tsparticles (and tsparticles-slim) for rain effect. Optimize for performance.
3d_libraries.instructions_to_main_agent: Create a RainBackground component with tsparticles config representing rain (lines falling downwards, speed 30-50, slight angle). Add a Lightning component that uses CSS animation to flash a white overlay div randomly. Ensure these components are fixed, pointer-events-none, and z-[-1].

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform, background-color.
NEVER center align the app container in CSS.
DO NOT use a completely transparent header over content without a blur/scrim.
Prioritize layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Ensure glass-morphism effects use high backdrop blur (12-24px) and semi-transparent borders.
Include subtle noise overlays for a cinematic texture.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Ensure routing includes Home, Books, Music, Videos, Store, Cart, Account, About, Blog, Contact, FAQ.
